hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); TOOL=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_name // ""'); if [[ "$TOOL" == "Bash" ]]; then CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -q 'grep' && echo "$CMD" | grep -q '\.swift'; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"SERENA REQUIRED: Use mcp__serena__search_for_pattern or mcp__serena__find_symbol instead of grep on Swift files."}}'; fi; elif [[ "$TOOL" == "Read" ]]; then FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); if [[ "$FILE" == *.swift ]]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"SERENA REQUIRED: Use mcp__serena__read_file, mcp__serena__find_symbol, or mcp__serena__replace_symbol_body instead of Read on Swift files."}}'; fi; fi
